verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents a strong headless/scriptable interface (the `exec` subcommand, JSON Lines event streaming, JSON Schema-conformant output) explicitly for CI pipelines and programmatic consumption, which functions as a de facto public automation API for AI-native drivers. However, probes show no REST/HTTP API or OpenAPI spec exists (all openapi.json/swagger.json paths 404), so it is CLI/exec-based only rather than a formally documented public API surface. Missing for 10: an actual HTTP/REST or RPC API with published schema (OpenAPI/swagger), and independent corroboration of the exec/headless interface being used for external automation.
